preconditions: Owned temporary source files and explicit fixture build/source declarations. Completion JSON is labelled planner data; one entropy test substitutes deterministic bytes. No production command is executed or durable work state published.
steps: Roundtrip original owned input bytes and all declared units through bounded-fanout manifest trees.
Relocate identical source bytes and verify unchanged semantic input/task bindings; change same-size content and observe different bindings.
Reject missing or damaged objects, unsafe input paths and a different expected tool build.

oracle.requirement_contract: Jeder aufgeteilte Auftrag MUSS ein gehashtes vollständiges Aufgaben- und Eingangsmanifest nach Anhang P besitzen.
oracle.scope: Initial work-v1 candidate hashes all supplied input bytes and the full caller-declared task plan in versioned segment trees. References bind ID, size, SHA-256 and count; missing or changed referenced data is rejected. Relative logical source locations survive relocation. Declared tool/source bindings are data, not independent provenance or an atomically captured snapshot. Full command-specific planners and portable persisted snapshots remain open.

open_items: Partial data contract only: trusted planner coverage and actual completion evidence, hostile input hardening, external expected work binding, consistent snapshot capture, safe work storage/locks, atomic durable publication, real resume and global finalization remain open. No Code 8, write authority, release approval or complete requirement satisfaction is claimed.
